First-time setup

Windows 10/11 (64-bit) and a visible in-game drop log. Guided setup helps you choose the game monitor, open Interface Edit Mode, and confirm both detected drop-log boxes. 4K and scaled interfaces are supported; the tracker measures your HUD scale and can adjust its rows from your session. Choose a mode, then a spot or recipe where needed. Gathering needs no spot selection. Stop to review and save.

Inside your dashboard

Follow your lifetime wealth curve, item breakdowns, per-spot results, averages, and personal bests. All five activities chart separately, including Gathering, so a losing batch stays visible. Weekday charts show your playtime. Group History by week, month, or spot: runs stay separate and the group headers add them up. Correct report quantities and material costs; saving the corrected report updates the same session. Grinding and hunting reports also let you add a missed drop.

Copy Image and paste a Loot Card into Discord, or save a PNG. Choose landscape or square. Grinding and hunting cards show your post-tax haul; cooking and alchemy cards show net profit and return on materials. Personal bests get the gold treatment.

Seeing an “unknown publisher” or download warning? Read the install guide.

The beta installer is unsigned, so Edge or Windows may show a warning. Download from the linked GitHub Releases page and check the source before choosing to continue. If you want to proceed, these are the steps shown in the existing installer walkthrough.

01 / EDGE DOWNLOAD

For “isn't commonly downloaded,” open ⋯ → Keep.

02 / EDGE CONFIRMATION

For “Make sure you trust…,” open Delete ▾ → Keep anyway.

03 / OPEN THE INSTALLER

If the publisher warning appears, choose Run to continue.

Some PCs instead show “Windows protected your PC,” with More info → Run anyway. The Edge steps don't apply in other browsers. If you're unsure or get stuck, ask in Discord.

For the readers. We see you.

The details.

Come say hello ↗
How does it work with BDO's anti-cheat?

See Safety for how capture works. This design is not an endorsement from Pearl Abyss or a guarantee about anti-cheat decisions.

Will it affect my FPS?

It uses desktop capture and CPU-based recognition while a session is running. It is designed to run alongside BDO, but performance depends on your PC and settings; there is no promise of zero overhead.

What do I need to get started?

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), BDO on the monitor you choose, and a visible drop log. 4K and other Interface Scales are supported. Guided setup detects both drop logs in Interface Edit Mode and lets you confirm or adjust their boxes. The tracker can then line up its rows from your session. For custom fonts it cannot detect, adjust the boxes manually. Live tracking needs the Windows app.

What can it track? Is Gathering available?

Grinding, hunting, cooking, alchemy, and Gathering. Hunting combines the drop log and Get-All loot panel. Cooking and alchemy count production and show net profit after your chosen ingredient costs; unpriced byproducts stay counted. Gathering is open to everyone — no tester code needed. It has one map-wide item scope, with no spot to choose: lumber, sap, ore, herbs, digging, underwater yields, blood, meat, and hides. Recognition coverage is still being built; new items can remain held for confirmation until real captures establish their identity.

How do I know the counts are right?

Recognition is checked against real sessions and hand-counted inventories. Approximate quantities are marked ≈; edit or re-enter the quantity to confirm it. High-value drops need corroborated identity evidence before entering totals; repeating a weak match is not enough. Held, unpriced, and unrecognized drops stay visible for review. Grinding and hunting reports also let you add a missed drop. If a read is wrong, send diagnostics so it can be investigated.

Does it use NA or EU market prices?

Both. Choose your market in Account → Set-up → Marketplace tax. Values use that region and your tax settings. The region picker is held while tracking. Changing regions clears cached prices; refresh Top Spots to reprice its board in the new region.

Can I pause or pick up a stopped run?

Yes. Pause and resume keep the clock and loot, without treating the pause as active time. Resume an accidentally stopped run from its review page. A just-saved grinding, hunting, or Gathering run can also be continued until you start another session or close the app; its next Save updates the same History entry. Older History sessions and saved cooking/alchemy batches cannot be resumed.

How are cooking and alchemy costs worked out?

Choose market prices, what you paid, or free materials you gathered yourself. Plan against your Materials stock, compare Buy or Make, and follow a shopping and crafting list. During a batch, see net profit so far and materials remaining. Review shows the planned consumption; Save deducts it from Materials once. With no material cost supplied, the result is gross, not verified net profit, and it does not qualify for the overall record.

Do you upload my session data?

Sessions are stored locally on your PC. The app uses network requests for market prices, community spot data, and update checks. If you report an issue, you choose to export and share diagnostics.

How do I report a missed or incorrect drop?

In the app, go to Account → App → Diagnostics → Export…. Post the exported file in Discord with the spot and roughly when it happened. It includes captured evidence around the read so the issue can be investigated.

Is it going to stay free?

Yes. Free during the beta, and free after it. It's a fan-made project built by a grinder who wanted better numbers. Useful feedback is the best thing you can give back.
